note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is not described; the description is taken from an unpublished manuscript by Bose; literature citations, distribution and figure numbers are omitted.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown, brown near base of mandibles; antennae slightly paler than head capsule, uniformly coloured; labrum brown; thorax, legs and abdomen creamy yellow. Pilosity of head and thorax sparse, of abdomen denser; posterior margin of each abdominal tergite with a row of hairs, a few hairs also scattered over the body. Body length 5.70–6.70 mm. Head subrectangular, sides weakly convex and narrowed anteriorly, longer than wide; length including mandibles 3.10–3.40 mm, length to base of mandibles 2.00 mm, maximum width 1.53–1.70 mm, width at base of mandibles 1.03–1.10 mm; width at base of mandibles about two-thirds of maximum width, index 0.64–0.66. Antennae 17-segmented, segments 3 and 5 subequal in length and shortest. Postclypeus indistinctly separated from frons, anterior part with one or two hairs on each side; anteclypeus linear, transparent. Labrum triangular, pointed at apex, 0.37–0.48 mm long, 0.33–0.38 mm wide; with 4 pairs of long setae, and one or two pairs of shorter hairs near the base. Mandibles sickle-shaped, tapering anteriorly, about half head length, 1.15–1.27 mm long, left mandible length/head length 0.56–0.59. Left mandible with one prominent tooth slightly below the middle, tooth 0.66–0.73 mm from apex, tooth distance/mandible length 0.566–0.580. Right mandible with one minute dot-like tooth at the position corresponding to the left mandibular tooth, sometimes difficult to discern. Postmentum subrectangular, widest at about the apical third, slightly narrowed posteriorly; anterior margin straight, posterior margin incurved; 1.15–1.30 mm long, 0.60–0.63 mm maximum width, 0.38–0.40 mm wide at anterior margin. Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin weakly notched at middle; posterior margin weakly concave, 0.63–0.70 mm long, 1.07–1.20 mm wide.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule yellow; antennae light brown; postclypeus concolorous with head capsule; thorax, legs and abdomen creamy yellow. Pilosity of head and body rather dense. Body length 4.70–5.03 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, slightly wider than length to base of mandibles; length to apex of labrum 1.90–2.03 mm, length to base of mandibles 1.35–1.40 mm, maximum width 1.60–1.78 mm. Fontanelle plate circular, situated on the mid-dorsum. Antennae 17–19-segmented. Postclypeus inflated, less than half as long as wide, 0.31 mm long, 0.75–0.85 mm wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped, 0.45–0.50 mm long, 0.80–1.10 mm wide. Minor worker: only smaller in size, otherwise as in major worker; head subcircular, antennae 17-segmented, segments 3 and 4 subequal in length; body length 3.70–3.90 mm, length to apex of labrum 1.33–1.40 mm, length to base of mandibles 0.85 mm, maximum head width 1.05–1.10 mm, pronotum 0.38–0.40 mm long, 0.65–0.70 mm wide.
